from: July book, night 11 (A Little Room for Elisha)
p1: In a town called Shunem lived a kind woman. Whenever Elisha came by, she fed him.
She told her husband, “He is a holy man who serves the Lord. Let’s make him a little room.” They put in a bed, a table, a stool and a lamp.
Elisha promised her a baby son, and he came! Years later, the boy got very sick and died.
p2: She laid him on Elisha’s bed and hurried to Elisha. Elisha came, shut the door and prayed. The boy grew warm. He sneezed seven times and opened his eyes! Prophets teach that because of Jesus, everyone will live again.
The woman made room for Elisha, and the Lord blessed her. Tonight, think of a way to make room for someone.
old: There was a kind woman who loved Heavenly Father. Whenever Elisha walked by, she gave him food. She told her husband, “Let’s make a little room for the prophet.” So they built him a cozy room with a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp.
Elisha was so thankful for her kindness. He wanted to do something nice for her too. He asked, “What can I do for you?” The woman had always wished for a baby.
Elisha said, “Next year you will hold a baby boy in your arms.” The woman could hardly believe it! And it came true — she had a sweet baby son. Heavenly Father blessed her kindness.
When we are kind and make room for others, Heavenly Father notices. He blesses people who serve quietly and lovingly. Kindness is never wasted. God remembers every good thing we do.
